doc.title: Ron Carter interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Over two thousand records, and goodbyes
summary: Carter says he has played on over two thousand records; they mention his Brazilian project and close the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Someone said you’ve played on about a thousand records.
I’ve been busy. Somebody’s got to do it, man.
Right. Thanks for your time. I know you have to go put some music together—
I’m going to work on it right now.
for the next set. And best of luck with your Brazilian project that you were telling me about.
And I appreciate your sneaking up here for some time.
I’m sorry I missed you yesterday, but now that’s squared away.
